Indicator 9, which tracks the fulfillment of epidural administration standards, is evaluated across seven Danish hospitals to determine if they meet the national threshold of greater than 60% compliance [^src1]. In the current reporting period (September 1, 2022, to August 31, 2023), five hospitals successfully met this target, while two fell significantly short [^src1]. 

[[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] emerged as the leader, achieving the highest fulfillment rate at 70.5% (95% CI: 62.2-77.9) [^src1]. It was joined in meeting the standard by [[regionshospitalet-horsens|Regionshospitalet Horsens]] (66.7%), [[esbjerg-sygehus-grindsted-sygehus|Esbjerg Sygehus Grindsted Sygehus]] (65.6%), [[regionshospitalet-goedstrup|Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]] (63.3%), and [[odense-universitetshospital-svendborg|Odense Universitetshospital - Svendborg]] (60.9%) [^src1]. Conversely, [[regionshospitalet-randers|Regionshospitalet Randers]] (40.6%) and [[regionshospital-nordjylland|Regionshospital Nordjylland]] (29.5%) failed to meet the standard, acting as the trailers in this comparison [^src1].

Looking at trends across the three reported periods (2020/21, 2021/22, and the current year), several hospitals demonstrated substantial improvement [^src1]. Most notably, [[odense-universitetshospital-svendborg|Odense Universitetshospital - Svendborg]] experienced a dramatic surge, jumping from a mere 5.7% in 2020/21 to 28.9% in 2021/22, and finally reaching 60.9% in the current year to cross the compliance threshold [^src1]. [[esbjerg-sygehus-grindsted-sygehus|Esbjerg Sygehus Grindsted Sygehus]] also showed strong, steady growth, rising from 38.6% to 65.6% over the same timeframe [^src1]. [[regionshospitalet-goedstrup|Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]] similarly improved from 47.8% to 63.3%, successfully meeting the target in the current year [^src1].

In contrast, the two hospitals that missed the target exhibited negative or stagnant trends [^src1]. [[regionshospital-nordjylland|Regionshospital Nordjylland]] experienced a steady decline across the three periods, dropping from 43.0% to 34.2%, and finally to 29.5% [^src1]. [[regionshospitalet-randers|Regionshospitalet Randers]] saw a slight increase from 44.0% to 47.8% in 2021/22, but regressed to 40.6% in the current year [^src1]. [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] remained relatively stable, dipping slightly from 68.6% to 63.7% before recovering to 70.5% [^src1]. The most striking outlier is the trajectory of [[odense-universitetshospital-svendborg|Odense Universitetshospital - Svendborg]], which transformed from the lowest-performing hospital in 2020/21 to a fully compliant facility in the current period [^src1].
